description: A soft, elegant bedroom in a pale warm-neutral palette with a polished residential hotel quality. The walls are smooth warm white plaster with a subtle wainscoting panel detail on the right side. The ceiling is white and smooth. Floor-to-ceiling curtain panels in a warm caramel-blush linen hang on the right wall, filtering daylight through a large window behind them into a warm diffused glow. The bed is full-width in the frame, with a tall button-tufted upholstered headboard in pale champagne velvet extending nearly from wall to wall. Crisp ivory-white bedding is layered with accent pillows in soft grey and pale butter-yellow, and an open magazine rests on the duvet. The nightstand on the right side is a light blonde-wood two-drawer piece with brass hardware; on it sits a small glass vase with a loose arrangement of peach and cream roses, two stacked books, and a secondary warm accent from a bedside source whose soft glow washes against the wall behind it. Above the nightstand, a framed abstract artwork in cream, sand, and muted blue-grey tones is hung on the wall. Warm amber glow diffuses from the ceiling-mounted source above, its light washing evenly over the bed and bedside table area, creating a warm, enveloping ambient quality. Camera is at standing eye-level, centered symmetrically on the bed, with the ceiling at the top of frame.
